name: Arcane Ascendancy
victoryScreenHeader: Become the master of all magic
victoryString: You have mastered the arcane arts and reshaped reality itself! Your civilization stands as the undisputed master of magic!
defeatString: You have been outmatched. Another civilization has achieved Arcane Ascendancy.

civilopediaText.text: Win by building the Reality Engine, accumulating 5000 Soul Power, and researching Reality Shaping.

name: Domination
victoryString: Your armies have crushed all opposition! The world bows before your might!
defeatString: Your civilization has been conquered. Another empire rules the world.

civilopediaText.text: Win by capturing all original capital cities.

name: Cultural
victoryScreenHeader: Influence all civilizations with your culture
victoryString: Your culture has conquered the world without a single sword being drawn! All nations look to you for inspiration!
defeatString: Your culture has been overshadowed. Another civilization has won a Cultural Victory.

civilopediaText.text: Win by becoming Influential over all civilizations with your culture.

name: Scientific
victoryScreenHeader: Launch a vessel to the stars
victoryString: Your civilization has reached for the stars and touched the infinite! A new age begins among the cosmos!
defeatString: You have been left behind. Another civilization has reached the stars first.

civilopediaText.text: Win by constructing all spaceship parts and adding them to your capital.

name: Diplomatic
victoryString: The world has chosen you as its leader! Through diplomacy and wisdom, you have united the realms!
defeatString: The world has chosen another leader. You have lost the diplomatic struggle.

civilopediaText.text: Win by being elected World Leader at the United Nations.
